general_notes: Each state has the same six treatments: (1) the target inside a dark border frame (best match); (2) a blurred copy of the target (exact composition, lost brushwork); (3) three dark-vignette candidates that look identical to each other (painted background replaced with black and a halo, character smaller); (4) three light-background candidates (nearly identical, though joyful I is paler) with washed-out flames, lost glow and cut-out edges, plus some character changes (head rim in idle and depleted, arm shape in joyful, streaky dress in fierce, foot artifact in depleted); (5) a zoomed round-vignette crop that cuts off the lower body; (6) a 3D/vector re-creation that is a different character style. Within each group I could not see differences at this resolution, so the members get identical scores, apart from joyful I. Uncertainty: the images are small (about 450-490 px), so fine differences between near-identical variants may be missed. The target depleted image already contains a grey rectangle near the bottom right, which the framed and blurred copies keep.
